Included C4D and OBJ files

VersionModel fileAccompanying files
C4DUnited_States_C4D.c4dMat_0.tif, Mat_1.tif, plan.png in the C4D texture folder
OBJ — LOD100United_States_OBJ.objUnited_States_OBJ.mtl and a texture folder containing Mat_0.tif and Mat_1.tif
OBJ — LOD50USA_50.objUSA_50.mtl
OBJ — LOD25USA_25.objUSA_25.mtl

OBJ files are included in this package. Keep each model with its accompanying material and texture files when preparing an import.

OBJ levels of detail

Choose from the supplied LOD100, LOD50 and LOD25 folders. Compare the versions in your software and select the mesh that suits your project. Check the imported geometry, units and material paths before building a scene.

Texture files

The archive contains TIF files named Mat_0.tif and Mat_1.tif in the LOD100 and C4D texture folders. The C4D folder also contains plan.png. Review the textures in your software to select the appearance you need.

Listed mesh specifications

The product listing describes an Albers Conic model with triangular polygon geometry, an open base and a frontal UV map. The listed C4D dimensions are 453.199 × 283.477 × 8.903 mm.

These are listing specifications. Check the selected file's dimensions, geometry and texture setup when preparing your project.

Choosing a USA model

Compare the file format, mesh and preview of each USA product before purchasing. A terrain-model package and a set of individual state models are separate product choices. If you need a particular geographic area, check the product preview and confirm the required coverage before ordering.

You can browse state terrain models to compare other modelling assets.

Questions before purchase

Do I need to request the OBJ version separately?

No. The package includes OBJ files in the LOD100, LOD50 and LOD25 folders.

Are STL and FBX files included?

The supplied model formats are C4D and OBJ. If you need a different format, confirm the requirements before purchasing.

Which textures accompany the models?

The LOD100 and C4D folders contain Mat_0.tif and Mat_1.tif. The C4D folder also contains plan.png.

Review the included model versions and texture files, then use Add to cart to purchase the digital terrain model.
